title: What Coffee Actually Does To Your Brain #Shorts

Caffeine does not give you energy. It blocks a chemical that makes you feel sleepy. Here is exactly what happens inside your brain 10 minutes, 45 minutes and 6 hours after that first cup.

#coffee #caffeine #science #brain #health

scenes.narration: Coffee does not give you energy. Nothing in that cup adds fuel to your body.
Caffeine looks almost like adenosine, so it blocks the receptors that make you feel tired. The tiredness is still there. You just cannot feel it.
Six hours later, half the caffeine is still in your bloodstream. That three o'clock cup is still working at nine.
Since the adenosine was only blocked, never cleared, it returns all at once. That is the crash. You were borrowing from tomorrow.
For sleep, cut off eight to ten hours before bed, and remember that the afternoon dip is not a coffee problem.
